title: Quantitative measurement & calibration
summary: Turn response into concentration with a defined calibration model, suitable standards, validated limits, and explicit reporting units.
zh_summary: 通过明确的校准模型、适当标准、已验证的限值及清楚的报告单位，将响应转换为浓度。

title: Experimental design & replication
summary: Define independent units, preserve pairing, balance batches, and plan replication around the comparison you want to make.
zh_summary: 定义独立单位、保留配对、平衡批次，并围绕预期比较规划重复。

title: QC, batch effects & normalization
zh_title: 质控、批次效应与归一化
summary: Use controls to diagnose drift, test correction assumptions, and distinguish a cleaner matrix from a more defensible measurement.
zh_summary: 利用质控诊断漂移、检验校正假设，并区分更整齐的数据矩阵与更有依据的测量。
